spec_match.rationale: Probes the real surfaces now — adapter.features 'subgroups' and the actual navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures set (the invented 'subgroup-uniformity' adapter-feature name is gone) — and the dispatched WGSL genuinely diverges per-lane; but the shader does not itself use subgroup intrinsics, so the uniformity feature is probed and explained rather than exercised (that is shader-playground's job).

interactive.rationale: Dispatch now does what it promises: a real compute pipeline, storage buffer, dispatchWorkgroups, timed readback and checksum on the GPU path, and the same branchy workload on the CPU when WebGPU/adapter/device is unavailable — the adapter-null case previously skipped the promised fallback and just showed an error.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede/code comment match the actual behaviour including the CPU fallback.

edge_cases.rationale: Three honest degradation paths (no navigator.gpu, null adapter, device/pipeline failure) all funnel into the labelled CPU fallback with the reason surfaced; the fallback explicitly states it cannot show subgroup effects.

references.rationale: chromestatus link added to see-also (was missing — invariant 3).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Adapter-null path verified via trusted CDP click (reason surfaced, CPU workload ran, wgslLanguageFeatures listed: packed_4x8_integer_dot_product et al); the GPU dispatch success path could NOT be executed here — requestAdapter() returns null in this headless sandbox even with SwiftShader flags — so it is code-reviewed and syntax-checked but not browser-verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for gpu-dispatch (mutation check) and cpu-fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the malformed </script role=...> tag (invalid HTML that also carried dead keyboard-handler attributes) is fixed to a plain </script>.

accessibility.rationale: Verdict panel is aria-live=polite (one message per run); sliders and button have accessible names.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth 360; stat cells wrap long feature names (overflow-wrap) after a minor clip was spotted in the desktop screenshot; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the WebGPU dispatch path on hardware
openQuestions.detail: requestAdapter() is null in this sandbox, so the pipeline/dispatch/readback path ran only through review. On a machine with WebGPU, confirm timings vary with the divergence slider and the checksum/mutation assert passes.

openQuestions.title: Use subgroup intrinsics when the adapter exposes 'subgroups'
openQuestions.detail: When adapter.features has 'subgroups', compile a second pipeline that keeps uniform control flow and uses subgroupAdd/subgroupBroadcast so the page can compare intrinsic vs plain throughput instead of only explaining it.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates aria-live countdown delayed action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce one meaningful result per action through a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdict div carries aria-live=polite and receives a single message per dispatch.

summary: Fixed four defects in place: the malformed </script role=...> close tag; the dispatch that never dispatched (now a real compute pipeline with timed readback + checksum); the skipped CPU fallback on null adapter (now runs the same branchy workload with the reason labelled); and the invented 'subgroup-uniformity' feature name (now honest adapter 'subgroups' + wgslLanguageFeatures listing). chromestatus link added. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
